name: elemental-production
description: Elemental Overwatch broadcast production companion — OBS overlay controller, FACEIT integration, and scene management.
author: Elemental Gaming <contact@elemental.gg>

scripts.dev: fuser -k 5173/tcp 3001/tcp 2>/dev/null; electron-vite build && concurrently --kill-others "vite" "node server/server.js" "sleep 3 && ELECTRON_IS_DEV=1 VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron ."
scripts.restart: fuser -k 3001/tcp 5173/tcp 2>/dev/null; rm -rf node_modules/.vite ~/.config/obs-studio/plugin_config/obs-browser/Cache ~/.config/obs-studio/plugin_config/obs-browser/GPUCache; npm run dev
scripts.dist: vite build && electron-vite build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: vite build && electron-vite build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: vite build && electron-vite build && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= electron-builder --linux
